As the body ages, natural collagen levels decline, leading to reduced elasticity, wrinkles, and dryness. Calmerceuticals Premium Liquid Collagen is designed to combat these effects, targeting dull, tired-looking skin and visible signs of ageing.

Each serving contains 10,000mg of Type 1 hydrolysed marine collagen, clinically proven to improve skin elasticity and reduce wrinkles. Enriched with hyaluronic acid, Cultavit®, polyphenols, and essential vitamins C and D, it delivers deep hydration and supports optimal collagen performance within the body.

Crafted with the highest quality ingredients in Australian laboratories, Calmerceuticals ensures safety, efficacy, and superior results. A daily sachet helps rebuild and restore collagen levels, boosting your body’s natural collagen and hyaluronic acid production. Each box contains 14 ready-to-drink sachets for convenient, effective beauty support.

Ultra Performance works by activating the body’s core performance systems - hormonal, neurological, and cellular - to help men perform, recover, and thrive. Its adaptogenic and nutrient-rich complex supports healthy testosterone production, stabilises stress hormones, and optimises energy metabolism to maintain consistent drive, stamina, and mental focus throughout the day.

At the cellular level, it enhances mitochondrial efficiency for sustained energy output while reducing inflammation and oxidative stress that can slow recovery and performance. The dual collagen system promotes structural integrity in joints and skin, supporting strength and resilience from within.

Together, these mechanisms create a synergistic effect - improving how the body produces energy, regulates hormones, and recovers - empowering men to feel sharper, stronger, and more in control, every day.

Patch Test Recommended

Before first use, apply a small amount to a discreet area of skin (such as behind the ear) and wait 24 hours to ensure compatibility.


For External Use Only

Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not apply to broken, irritated, or inflamed skin.


Keep Out of Reach of Children

Use only as directed. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.


Storage

Store below 25°C in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Ensure the cap is tightly closed after each use to maintain product freshness.


Shelf Life

Best used within 12 months after opening.

Peptides (Tripeptide-29, Tetrapeptide-3, Copper, Biotinoyl)
settings.text: Clinically proven to strengthen the foundation of your hair from the root up. This powerhouse peptide complex helps rebuild the scalp’s structural proteins, boost follicle density, and stimulate renewal at the cellular level for visibly thicker, stronger strands over time.

settings.title: Argan & Rosemary Oils
settings.text: Nutrient-dense botanical oils that deeply nourish, hydrate, and smooth. Argan oil delivers antioxidant-rich moisture to repair dryness and add luminous shine, while rosemary oil helps improve scalp circulation and has been clinically linked to thicker, denser hair over time.

settings.title: Caffeine & EGCG (Green Tea Extract)
settings.text: A high-performance duo that reawakens dormant follicles and kickstarts growth. Caffeine increases scalp microcirculation for better nutrient delivery, while EGCG, a potent antioxidant, helps protect follicles from oxidative stress and hormonal damage that can slow growth or cause shedding.

settings.title: Biotin & Niacinamide (Vitamin B7 + B3)
settings.text: Two essential vitamins that fortify and thicken each strand from within. Biotin supports keratin production for stronger hair structure, while Niacinamide enhances circulation and improves barrier function at the scalp, helping to reduce breakage and promote visibly fuller, healthier growth.

settings.title: Fermented Shilajit
settings.text: A mineral-rich adaptogen that revitalises the scalp at a deep biological level. Packed with fulvic acid and trace elements, fermented Shilajit helps restore balance, energy, and vitality to the scalp microbiome creating the optimal environment for strong, resilient hair to thrive.

settings.title: Hyaluronic Acid & Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5)
settings.text: Advanced hydration technology for scalp comfort and elasticity. Hyaluronic acid binds moisture to both scalp and hair fibre, while Panthenol strengthens the cuticle and seals in hydration leaving hair soft, supple, and visibly more resilient with every use.

settings.title: What does Premium Hair Serum do?
settings.text: Premium Hair Serum helps improve the visible condition of both hair and scalp. It can enhance shine, smoothness, and manageability while supporting the appearance of thicker, fuller-looking hair.

settings.title: Is this serum suitable for all hair types?
settings.text: Yes. The lightweight, non-greasy formula is suitable for all hair types including fine, thick, straight, wavy, and curly hair.

settings.title: Can I use it every day?
settings.text: Absolutely. It’s designed for daily use — morning, evening, or both — to help maintain soft, healthy-looking hair and a balanced-feeling scalp.

settings.title: Is it safe for coloured or chemically treated hair?
settings.text: Yes. It’s colour-safe and formulated without harsh ingredients like sulfates, parabens, or silicones, making it gentle on coloured and treated hair.

settings.title: Is it vegan and cruelty-free?
settings.text: Yes. Premium Hair Serum is 100% vegan, cruelty-free, and made in Australia with ethically sourced ingredients.

settings.title: How should I apply it?
settings.text: Apply to clean, dry or towel-dried hair. Dispense a few drops directly onto the scalp and massage gently. Do not rinse. Style as usual.

settings.title: How soon will I see results?
settings.text: Most users notice improved smoothness, shine, and manageability within a few weeks of consistent use. Visible results may vary depending on your hair type and routine.

settings.title: Can I use it with other styling or treatment products?
settings.text: Yes. Premium Hair Serum absorbs quickly and layers seamlessly under styling products, heat protectants, or leave-in conditioners.

settings.title: Does it leave a greasy residue?
settings.text: No. The serum has a lightweight, fast-absorbing texture that leaves hair soft, smooth, and touchable, never oily or sticky.

settings.title: Can I use it with a scalp massager or derma roller?
settings.text: Yes, it can be applied before using a gentle scalp massager to enhance product absorption and relaxation. Avoid use on broken or irritated skin.
